# Service Payment

Each Service Payment method is documented on its own page:

- [Get services list](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/list)

- [Get service fields](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/fields)

- [Get service information](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/info)

- [Create transaction](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/create)

- [Pay transaction](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/pay)

- [Cancel transaction](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/cancel)

- [Get transaction status](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/transaction-status)

- [Get all transactions](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/transactions)

- [Errors and FAQ](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/service-payment/errors)

## Notes (extraction)
- The EN, RU and UZ `.html` URLs serve this content with HTTP 200. The extensionless URLs redirect to directory URLs that returned HTTP 404 during verification. Overview links point to the respective locale’s endpoint pages.
- EN, RU and UZ agree on the operations and link targets; labels and introductory prose are translated.
